skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze theoretical and practical issues in agricultural economics.
Identify appropriate agricultural policies based on economic analysis.
Apply research methods to gather and analyze data in agricultural economics.
Demonstrate critical thinking in evaluating economic issues.
Propose solutions to economic problems in agriculture.
Actively choose research methods and materials for analyzing real-world economic situations.
Work collaboratively with peers and instructors.
Effectively present research findings and defend the thesis.
